name: Tourist Entry / Visitor Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Paraguay grants visa-free entry based on bilateral/unilateral agreements dating to 1959. 90 days: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Uruguay, most EU states, Australia, Canada, Japan, New Zealand, Russia, South Korea, Taiwan, Turkey, the US. 60 days: Dominican Republic. 30 days: Bolivia, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, El Salvador, Finland, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico, Nicaragua, Panama, Peru, among others. All other nationalities need a visa issued by a Paraguayan diplomatic mission before travel; some nationalities can get a 15- or 30-day visa on arrival instead. An online application exists for visa-required nationalities, but it still requires an in-person visit to a Paraguayan embassy/consulate to complete.
requirements.fix_path: If not on the visa-exempt list, apply through a Paraguayan embassy/consulate (with the option to start the process online) before traveling, or check on-arrival visa eligibility for your nationality.

evidence_required.document: Passport valid for the intended stay

outcome.duration_length: 15-90 days depending on nationality and entry type
